text:
nina: Quick preflight - can we add an embeddings smoke-test to the adapter onramp? Partners (LangChain/LlamaIndex) often assume embedding shape/normalization.

omar: yes, we should. Minimal test: 512-dim vectors, deterministic seed, cosine similarity sanity check.

sam: Agree. Suggest including a tiny fixture in the bundle: `/tests/embeddings/seed_prompts.json` and a validator that asserts dims + non-nan values.

maria: Also need to confirm marketplace docs require an embeddings example and a sample client snippet. I can add a template.

devon: Partner Eng will add `rw-validate embeddings` check to the validator CLI. Local run: `rw-validate ./bundle.tgz --check embeddings`. We'll mark bundles failing as gating for marketplace.

nina: Nice. Also, for gateway adapters: ensure the adapter exposes an `embed` RPC with stable param names: `input_tokens`, `normalize=true|false`. Sam, can you propose the exact field names?

sam: Will draft. Also flag: LlamaIndex uses `embed_model` in a few places; we'll add a compatibility shim in the adapter.

partner-bot: Reminder created: "Embedding checks + adapter onramp" Tue 11:00 PT (organizer: nina).

maria: Action items: sam draft param names, devon add validator check, I'll update marketplace template and invite LangChain/LlamaIndex contacts.

nina: Thanks team. Keep it small and automatable so we can fast-track ISV listings.
